name: Thin Air
overview: A hugely popular moderate up the middle of a pale granite face, with positive holds and a long rightward traverse where the second needs protecting.
beta: Start slightly left where it is easier, or ascend directly on solid holds for roughly fifty feet, arriving at a piton-equipped stance. The second pitch is a long traverse rightward; use whatever fixed gear is there and look after your second.
descent: Do not rap the line itself: two double-rope raps down the face to its left, or walk off right along the tree ledge
